{"ok": true, "path": "telegram/_message.py", "start_line": 4822, "end_line": 4965, "total_lines": 5183, "truncated": false, "content": "4822:    def _parse_markdown(
4823:        cls,
4824:        message_text: Optional[str],
4825:        entities: dict[MessageEntity, str],
4826:        urled: bool = False,
4827:        version: MarkdownVersion = 1,
4828:        offset: int = 0,
4829:    ) -> Optional[str]:
4830:        if version == 1:
4831:            for entity_type in (
4832:                MessageEntity.EXPANDABLE_BLOCKQUOTE,
4833:                MessageEntity.BLOCKQUOTE,
4834:                MessageEntity.CUSTOM_EMOJI,
4835:                MessageEntity.SPOILER,
4836:                MessageEntity.STRIKETHROUGH,
4837:                MessageEntity.UNDERLINE,
4838:            ):
4839:                if any(entity.type == entity_type for entity in entities):
4840:                    name = entity_type.name.title().replace("_", " ")  # type:ignore[attr-defined]
4841:                    raise ValueError(f"{name} entities are not supported for Markdown version 1")
4842:
4843:        if message_text is None:
4844:            return None
4845:
4846:        utf_16_text = message_text.encode(TextEncoding.UTF_16_LE)
4847:        markdown_text = ""
4848:        last_offset = 0
4849:
4850:        sorted_entities = sorted(entities.items(), key=lambda item: item[0].offset)
4851:        parsed_entities = []
4852:
4853:        for entity, text in sorted_entities:
4854:            if entity in parsed_entities:
4855:                continue
4856:
4857:            nested_entities = {
4858:                e: t
4859:                for (e, t) in sorted_entities
4860:                if e.offset >= entity.offset
4861:                and e.offset + e.length <= entity.offset + entity.length
4862:                and e != entity
4863:            }
4864:            parsed_entities.extend(list(nested_entities.keys()))
4865:
4866:            if nested_entities:
4867:                if version < 2:
4868:                    raise ValueError("Nested entities are not supported for Markdown version 1")
4869:
4870:                escaped_text = cls._parse_markdown(
4871:                    text,
4872:                    nested_entities,
4873:                    urled=urled,
4874:                    offset=entity.offset,
4875:                    version=version,
4876:                )
4877:            else:
4878:                escaped_text = escape_markdown(text, version=version)
4879:
4880:            if entity.type == MessageEntity.TEXT_LINK:
4881:                if version == 1:
4882:                    url = entity.url
4883:                else:
4884:                    # Links need special escaping. Also can't have entities nested within
4885:                    url = escape_markdown(
4886:                        entity.url, version=version, entity_type=MessageEntity.TEXT_LINK
4887:                    )
4888:                insert = f"[{escaped_text}]({url})"
4889:            elif entity.type == MessageEntity.TEXT_MENTION and entity.user:
4890:                insert = f"[{escaped_text}](tg://user?id={entity.user.id})"
4891:            elif entity.type == MessageEntity.URL and urled:
4892:                link = text if version == 1 else escaped_text
4893:                insert = f"[{link}]({text})"
4894:            elif entity.type == MessageEntity.BOLD:
4895:                insert = f"*{escaped_text}*"
4896:            elif entity.type == MessageEntity.ITALIC:
4897:                insert = f"_{escaped_text}_"
4898:            elif entity.type == MessageEntity.CODE:
4899:                # Monospace needs special escaping. Also can't have entities nested within
4900:                insert = f"`{escape_markdown(text, version, MessageEntity.CODE)}`"
4901:            elif entity.type == MessageEntity.PRE:
4902:                # Monospace needs special escaping. Also can't have entities nested within
4903:                code = escape_markdown(text, version=version, entity_type=MessageEntity.PRE)
4904:                if entity.language:
4905:                    prefix = f"```{entity.language}\n"
4906:                elif code.startswith("\\"):
4907:                    prefix = "```"
4908:                else:
4909:                    prefix = "```\n"
4910:                insert = f"{prefix}{code}```"
4911:            elif entity.type == MessageEntity.UNDERLINE:
4912:                insert = f"__{escaped_text}__"
4913:            elif entity.type == MessageEntity.STRIKETHROUGH:
4914:                insert = f"~{escaped_text}~"
4915:            elif entity.type == MessageEntity.SPOILER:
4916:                insert = f"||{escaped_text}||"
4917:            elif entity.type in (MessageEntity.BLOCKQUOTE, MessageEntity.EXPANDABLE_BLOCKQUOTE):
4918:                insert = ">" + "\n>".join(escaped_text.splitlines())
4919:                if entity.type == MessageEntity.EXPANDABLE_BLOCKQUOTE:
4920:                    insert = f"{insert}||"
4921:            elif entity.type == MessageEntity.CUSTOM_EMOJI:
4922:                # This should never be needed because ids are numeric but the documentation
4923:                # specifically mentions it so here we are
4924:                custom_emoji_id = escape_markdown(
4925:                    entity.custom_emoji_id,
4926:                    version=version,
4927:                    entity_type=MessageEntity.CUSTOM_EMOJI,
4928:                )
4929:                insert = f"![{escaped_text}](tg://emoji?id={custom_emoji_id})"
4930:            else:
4931:                insert = escaped_text
4932:
4933:            # Make sure to escape the text that is not part of the entity
4934:            # if we're in a nested entity, this is still required, since in that case this
4935:            # text is part of the parent entity
4936:            markdown_text += (
4937:                escape_markdown(
4938:                    utf_16_text[last_offset * 2 : (entity.offset - offset) * 2].decode(
4939:                        TextEncoding.UTF_16_LE
4940:                    ),
4941:                    version=version,
4942:                )
4943:                + insert
4944:            )
4945:
4946:            last_offset = entity.offset - offset + entity.length
4947:
4948:        # see comment above
4949:        markdown_text += escape_markdown(
4950:            utf_16_text[last_offset * 2 :].decode(TextEncoding.UTF_16_LE),
4951:            version=version,
4952:        )
4953:
4954:        return markdown_text
4955:
4956:    @property
4957:    def text_markdown(self) -> str:
4958:        """Creates an Markdown-formatted string from the markup entities found in the message
4959:        using :class:`telegram.constants.ParseMode.MARKDOWN`.
4960:
4961:        Use this if you want to retrieve the message text with the entities formatted as Markdown
4962:        in the same way the original message was formatted.
4963:
4964:        Warning:
4965:            |text_markdown|"}

`text_markdown_v2_urled` calls `_parse_markdown(self.text, self.parse_entities(), urled=True, version=2)`. In `_parse_markdown`, entities are processed by offset order. The bold entity contains the italic entity, so the nested recursive call formats `"bold and italic"` as `"bold and _italic_"`, and the outer bold wraps that as `*bold and _italic_*`. For the URL with `urled=True`, the visible link text is the Markdown-v2-escaped URL, so `.` and `_` become `\.` and `\_`, yielding `[http://example\.com/a\_b](http://example.com/a_b)`. The code entity is wrapped with backticks as `` `x_y` ``, and the plain text between entities is appended unchanged except for Markdown escaping where needed.

{"markdown_text":"start *bold and _italic_* end plus [http://example\\.com/a\\_b](http://example.com/a_b) and code `x_y`"}
